families.name: PixelwoodC_Codex_CurtainWaterfall
families.note: Broad blue curtain with a lighter central ribbon and comb-shaped lip/foot foam. 48 displayed pixels per tile; no standing stone or chest included.

families.name: PokeA_Codex_TerraceWaterfall
families.note: Repeated short bright-blue terrace falls; western and bridge-adjacent examples share this size. Small white shoreline corners are not separate falls.

families.name: PokeC_Codex_FiveTierCascade
families.note: Wide upper five-band cascade interpreted as five shallow descending sheets linked by shelves.

families.name: PokeC_Codex_ThreeTierCascade
families.note: Lower three-band cascade, narrower and shorter than the northern waterfall.

families.name: PokeD_Codex_UpperWaterfall
families.note: Northern green-water fall with irregular pale crest and a curling foam foot. Inlet is clipped by the image; a short inlet tab is inferred.

families.name: PokeD_Codex_WideSpillway
families.note: Wide shallow central spillway between rock banks; stretched lip and brief falling curtain.

families.name: PokeD_Codex_NarrowWaterfall
families.note: Narrower southwest curtain; the adjacent boulders are existing rock assets.

families.name: PokeM_Codex_FoamySpillway
families.note: Low foamy river lip repeated at about (411,608) and (420,834). Reeds and shore outlines are excluded.

families.name: PokeS_Codex_TallGardenWaterfall
families.note: Tall northwestern bounded fall; repeated foam ribs are surface flow bands, not separate solid terraces.

families.name: PokeS_Codex_MediumGardenWaterfall
families.note: Northeastern bounded waterfall; rounded foam foot below several flow bands.

families.name: PokeS_Codex_LowGardenWaterfall
families.note: Low central-east terrace fall, distinct from the longer northern curtain.

families.name: PokeS_Codex_NarrowGardenWaterfall
families.note: Narrow western garden drop; short top-edge and west-central copies reuse this appearance.

families.name: PokeS_Codex_WideGardenWaterfall
families.note: Wider short drop below the eastern bridge; matching western drops reuse this family.

families.name: PokeS_Codex_LongIslandWaterfall
families.note: Long central floating-island fall, extended down toward lower water. Foot mist is inferred; no invented rocky bottom basin.

families.name: PokeS_Codex_IslandWaterfall
families.note: Other long island-edge curtains, including the west (about 118,530), use this shorter length. Depth and hidden termination are inferred.

families.name: PokeS_Codex_NarrowIslandWaterfall
families.note: Slender lower-west island drop, partly obscured near the lower end; completed with modest attached mist.

families.name: PokeS_Codex_SoutheastWaterfall
families.note: Southeastern narrow curtain terminating into the visible lower stream; differs from the long unbounded curtains.

families.name: PokeU_Codex_UpperRibbonFall
families.note: Thin blue falling-water ribbon behind the northern house; inlet and lower end are occluded/cropped. 64-voxel completed length is an explicit estimate.

families.name: PokeU_Codex_LowerRibbonFall
families.note: Lower island notch ribbon with a pale mist foot. Blue atmospheric gaps without a visible water ribbon are excluded.

families.name: PokeP_Codex_RockCaveEntrance
families.note: Small pointed pale-rock surround in the upper gully, with a real open tunnel and a recessed earthy floor. Unseen depth is inferred.

families.name: PokeT_Codex_AmberCaveEntrance
families.note: Eastern warm brown rounded cave mouth near the sign; real arch opening, faceted rock brow and short through-tunnel.

families.name: PokeT_Codex_DeepCavernEntrance
families.note: Large irregular southern dark recess reconstructed as a deep cavern mouth. The source black void beyond the entrance is background, not exported geometry; hidden roof/rear tunnel are inferred.
